nom: La Roche-Posay Serozinc Mattifying Facial Toner Spray

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin most often report reduced shine and smaller-looking pores with regular use, though several say it made no difference or even left them oilier than before.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results, some finding it too drying or unsuitable in winter while others say it helps moisturizer sink in better without stripping the skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it keeps the oily zones (t-zone) balanced and helps setting makeup, with one noting it suits combo-acne-prone skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin, including those with dermatitis, describe it as soothing, non-irritating and a rare product that calms breakouts and redness rather than causing them.
segments.mature: One reviewer with mature normal-to-dry skin reports the product leaves skin feeling smooth and firm.

concerns.aging: One reviewer linked consistent use to smoother skin and fading fine lines over two months; this is a single unverified account rather than a common finding.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers say it hydrates and helps other products absorb better, plumping the skin when layered with hyaluronic acid, but a few others found it too drying, especially in winter, leaving skin tight afterward.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with dermatitis, irritation, or sunburn report the mist calms redness and inflammation quickly, sometimes within a day.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer prone to barrier issues and perioral dermatitis reports the product restored balance and cleared breakouts overnight; this is an isolated but detailed account.
concerns.spots: Reports are mixed: several reviewers with large pores say pores look visibly smaller after repeated use, while at least three say they saw no change in pore size at all.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers who mention breakouts say the mist helped clear or reduce them, including as a spot treatment, but two reviewers report new pimples or cystic-type breakouts appearing after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: Many oily-skin reviewers report visibly less shine and oil throughout the day, especially in summer, but a notable minority say it did nothing for oil control or even increased shine.

aspects.libelle: Feels like plain water, no effect
Large bottle, good value per use

extraits.titre: If you are prone to dermatitis, listen up!!!!
extraits.texte: I am prone to dermatitis. When I say most products are a miss for me as I have very reactive skin…. I mean it!!! I am prone to barrier issues, struggle with hormonal acne, & perioral dermatitis on top of that. I consistently look for balance in my skincare. This delivered just that!! I use this every other night before serums. My skin instantly feels smooth!! I had a dermatitis breakout and the next morning it was cleared because of this. If you have dry skin this may not be your favorite product. However, if you have oily skin I really do believe you'll love this. I want to add this doesn't give your skin a dull matte look so if you're looking for that, this aint it.

extraits.titre: La Roche Posay Serozinc Face Mist
extraits.texte: This mist is fragrance free which is nice especially if you prefer skincare without fragrance. The continuous mist sprays quite nicely, leaving a even coating on the face and dries quite quickly. I used this for a few days and really wanted to enjoy it however, I feel, that this product isn't made to be used in the winter, at least for my skin. I found it to be too drying for me as I need something more moisturizing. I would definitely give it another shot when warmer weather rolls around. This could definitely be a good summer product when my skin is more oily in the summer.

extraits.titre: Not good for acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I really wanted to love this product cause it was goving me really smooth skin but after a week of using it, it started giving me really big pimples

For years I have been trying to find products that work on my skin. I have very oily skin and look older than I am. Even using "anti-aging" didn't help with the "looking older" and only made my skin more oily. Approximately, two months ago I found and purchased this moisturizer (and some other products from La Roche-Posay) and can not believe the difference in two months! I could actually wipe the oil off my face every hour before and now maybe once or twice a day I do it. Each day my skin is better than the day before. Breakouts are happening less and fine lines are smoothing away. I also love how refreshing this feels after applying it! I can not wait to see how much better it will get in the coming months.

I really like this product, I have mature normal to dry skin and I love how it makes my skin feel. I use Serozinc Face Mist after I wash my face, It seems to leave me with skin that's smooth and firm.

Lately because of how irritated my skin can get; I now only use Dr. Barbara Sturm skincare and her supplements to help skin from the inside out and after I started using it and now after a few months; wow realized this brand is for real and my skin has never felt better so I haven't used any other brands other than hers but when I saw this and saw the ingredients which are excellent I gave it a try and I will definitely be repurchasing for me it helps some of my skincare sink in a bit more I have found which is awesome for the days I need my skin cream to sink in fast so I can wear makeup on the days I work. This is a BEAUTIFUL SPRAY! The nozzle is better than the Evian one and it's ingredients are better as well. I have the most iriitated skin in the world most skin mists I try just make my skin red and also flaky because I have such dry skin but this la roch posay spray is amazing the fine mist it give your face is like a magical dream it helps wake you up in the morning as well with a quick spritz I think the can will last me a long time . Best item I've gotten from Influenster's where I received this item for free for reviewing purposes. And I will definitely be repurchasing even my sister loved it!

This face mist is nice to have around if you have oily skin. The bottle sprays a super fine mist that feels really refreshing on the skin. If your skin is feeling a bit oily throughout the day, it will mattify it. It doesn't work as well if you let your skin get too oily. I also think it didn't do anything when it came to preventing my skin from becoming oily.
